action: Look up RoboRide Inc on the library computers Tuesday afternoon — not to make any decision, but to understand what the service actually involves. How does one summon a vehicle? What is the cost per ride? Is there an app required, and if so, is it the kind of app I can learn? I helped three people set up telehealth accounts last week. I can learn an app.
